identification: Horizontally opposed twin-cylinder two-stroke petrol model aircraft engine (roughly 40-60cc class): Walbro-type diaphragm carburettor on a brown phenolic spacer between the cylinders, electronic ignition module (silver box, red/black leads) fitted on the side, braided fuel line, grey/faded-black finned cylinders with exhaust port gaskets showing. With it: two cast aluminium elbow exhaust headers and a twin-inlet aluminium canister muffler, a glass funnel/fuel bottle, red bench vice (rusty jaws), assorted files, Workzone spring assortment, grey plastic tool case (contents unseen), and a TY-1 M3-M12 tap/thread gauge set in a wooden box.

viewing_check: Photograph the crankcase (front and underside), cylinder heads and the ignition module label for maker and cc (DLE, RCGF/Stinger, NGH, EME, Turnigy TP, BME). Turn the prop hub by hand for compression on both cylinders, check spark plug caps and hall sensor are present, check for cracked fins or stripped threads, and see what is in the grey plastic case.
